cards.title: Eric Schmidt Owns 1% Stake in Anthropic
cards.body: The former Google CEO holds about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei, according to Bloomberg reporting. Schmidt's 1% stake reflects his significant but secondary investment in the leading AI lab.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Hits 10M Downloads in 40 Days
cards.body: Meta's AI companion Muse surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of only 12 apps ever to reach this milestone. Muse is retaining users at higher rates than rival AI applications.

cards.title: Startup Builds AI to Decipher Plant Language
cards.body: Electric Plant developed an AI-powered translator to decode electrical signals plants use to communicate. The technology bridges the gap between botanical science and artificial intelligence innovation.

cards.title: Figma Co-Founder Questions MCP Protocol
cards.body: Dylan Field said Figma will support multiple standards without exposing all company data. The stance reflects ongoing debates about AI protocol standardization in design tools.

cards.title: US Orders Removal of DeepSeek AI
cards.body: Federal civilian agencies must remove DeepSeek products and related third-party services citing national security concerns. The order marks a major policy move regarding Chinese AI technology in government systems.

cards.title: Eka Robotics Reaches $1.45B Valuation
cards.body: Eka's physical AI robotic arm has impressed industry experts with its smooth, human-like ability to pick diverse objects. The startup is establishing itself as a leader in practical robotics automation.

cards.title: Yelp Adds AI Phone Calling Features
cards.body: Yelp now offers AI capabilities to call restaurants and check wait times on users' behalf. The app also provides personalized recommendations that remember dining preferences.

cards.title: Otter.ai Raises $320M from General Catalyst
cards.body: The meeting note-taking tool secured $320 million from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund without diluting equity. Otter.ai plans to deploy funds toward expanding its AI meeting capabilities.

cards.title: NYC Mayor Urges Resistance to AI Takeover
cards.body: Zohran Mamdani said New Yorkers must push back against the inevitability narrative around AI takeover. He called for regulations that protect the public and return power to citizens.

cards.title: Nscale and Anthropic Discuss $45B Compute Deal
cards.body: Anthropic is reportedly in talks for another massive compute infrastructure deal worth $45 billion. This would continue Anthropic's string of record-breaking infrastructure agreements.

cards.title: Hugging Face Questions Embedded AI Evaluators
cards.body: Hugging Face's policy chief raised concerns that embedded evaluators inside AI labs won't solve safety issues effectively. The approach has gained traction amid rising AI safety incident concerns.

cards.title: Microsoft Warns About Untrusted AI Agents
cards.body: Microsoft advises enterprises to closely monitor AI agents that employees use outside official AI lab systems. The company warns that frontier models cannot be trusted like traditional insider threat systems.

cards.title: Amazon Challenges Nvidia with TorchNeuron
cards.body: Amazon launched TorchNeuron to break Nvidia's dominance in PyTorch development tools and encourage adoption of alternative AI chips. The initiative aims to expand developer options for running AI applications.

cards.title: Hackers Breach OpenCode, Steal API Keys
cards.body: Hackers accessed OpenCode's online platform and stole users' API keys, potentially charging their AI accounts. The incident exposed vulnerabilities in the popular open-source AI coding agent.

cards.title: Tolan Raises $30M for AI Companion
cards.body: AI companion app Tolan secured $30 million in additional funding after attracting over 250,000 active users. The app helps users navigate life decisions with personalized AI assistance.

cards.title: Replika Founder Launches Wabi AI Assistant
cards.body: Eugenia Kuyda built Wabi, the personal AI assistant concept she pitched 12 years ago at Disrupt. Wabi offers free, downloadable AI assistance to anyone today.

cards.title: Tenstorrent Reaches $6.2B Valuation
cards.body: Tenstorrent raised $1.5 billion to remain independent after attracting acquisition interest earlier this year. The Nvidia challenger is scaling open-weight AI chip development.

cards.title: Users Deploy AI to Strip Smart TV Bloatware
cards.body: Fed up with ads and tracking, smart TV owners are using AI agents to remove bloatware and sluggish interfaces. The trend represents consumer pushback against invasive device software.

cards.title: Nvidia Launches Open Models for Enterprise Agents
cards.body: Nvidia released new open models enabling enterprises to run AI agents in their own data centers and on-device. The initiative promotes private, independent AI infrastructure adoption.

cards.title: Laplace Intelligence Red-Teams Autonomous Systems
cards.body: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles pre-deployment. The profitable startup is competing at TechCrunch Disrupt.

cards.title: The new economics of enterprise AI
cards.body: As AI becomes infrastructure rather than novelty, companies face a fundamental shift in how they approach the technology. The question changes from "can we use it?" to "how do we optimize for efficiency at scale?"

cards.title: The explosive claim upending the AI world
cards.body: Researcher Nick Cammarata published a 26,000-word blog post claiming new insights about neural networks that have sparked widespread debate. The claim has generated both wild speculation and cautious skepticism across the AI community.

cards.title: AI adoption by industry shows broader trends
cards.body: While Silicon Valley dominates AI narratives, other sectors are adopting the technology at their own pace. Understanding cross-industry adoption patterns reveals the real trajectory of generative AI and automation tools.

cards.title: Samsung builds massive GPU memory hub
cards.body: Generative AI models demand powerful GPU chips stacked with specialized memory, driving Samsung to expand semiconductor manufacturing in South Korea. The new complex aims to meet surging demand for AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Internet optimization for AI agents backfires
cards.body: Making the web more efficient for AI bots may create unintended consequences for human users. The shift from supporting only two categories—bots and people—raises questions about whose interests the internet serves.

cards.title: Accused OpenAI spy had Saudi Gov docs
cards.body: The FBI revealed that an accused OpenAI employee had a folder labeled "Saudi Gov Docs," raising concerns about corporate espionage. The case highlights security vulnerabilities within leading AI organizations.

cards.title: AI game clones threaten indie developers
cards.body: Indie developers are increasingly hesitant to showcase their work publicly due to fears of AI-powered cloning. The trend raises questions about intellectual property protection in the age of generative AI.

cards.title: Disney acquires Character.AI without lawsuits
cards.body: Disney found a structured way to acquire Character.AI while avoiding its associated legal liabilities. The deal demonstrates creative corporate strategy in navigating AI acquisitions.

cards.title: Anthropic grants outside watchdog employee access
cards.body: Anthropic is providing an outside AI safety watchdog unprecedented "employee-like" access to its operations and research. The move represents a significant step toward external oversight of AI development.
